Game Overview

In Line of Hole, the core idea is straightforward: embark on a captivating puzzle adventure in Line of Hole, where connecting dots on a grid challenges your strategic thinking. As complexity rises, craft continuous lines to earn coins for mesmerizing aesthetic upgrades, enhancing your visual experience. Master each level with precision and style.
